title: Wu Ting Fang

page_data.en:
C: I. D.
F. O. REG
No. 202
Date 28/3/16

Municipal Police.
CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION DEPT.
Captain Superintendent's Office

Shanghai, March 27th 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that the rebel leaders held a meeting
in No.32 Admiral Bayle on 25th instant when they decided to
deposit their funds in the Banque de l'Indo-Chine, provided
satisfactory arrangements can be made.
It is said that a man from the Japanese Consulate
calls frequently at No.32 Amiral Bayle.
Two military officers from the Arsenal are now assist-
ing the police officers in censoring letters in the Chinese
Post Office. They started on 25th instant.
One hundred and eighty recruits arrived in Woosung
on the morning of 26th instant from the North.
X It is reported that Chen Chi Mei has been showing
himself more than usual for the past few days. He has
grown whiskers.
X It is reported that Wu Ting Fang 伍庭芳 and Tang
Shao Yi 唐紹儀 have sent letters to the rebel headquarters
in Shanghai repudiating the allegation that they consented
to act as peacemakers between the Republicans and Monarchists
and expressing their willingness to subscribe to the
rebel funds.
It is reported that a rebel leader named Chen Tscheng
Hsuen 岑春煊 has arrived here from Yunnan.
While discussing politics at a tiffin party at
the Arsenal on 26th instant Deputy Military Governor La
and one of General Yang's staff officers named Wong.
Ping 王宏 quarrelled and came to blows. The other
guests, who included General Yang and the Director
of the Arsenal made peace.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Enclosed on m.s. March 27.

C: I. D.
F. O. REG
第 202 号
日期 1916年3月28日

工部局警务处。
刑事调查科
警司办公室

上海，1916年3月27日。

先生：

据报，反叛首领于本月25日在百乐路（Amiral Bayle）32号举行会议，会上决定若能作出令人满意的安排，便将其资金存入东方汇理银行（Banque de l'Indo-Chine）。

据悉，一名来自日本领事馆的人员频繁前往百乐路32号。

两名来自兵工厂的军官目前正协助警务人员在华邮局检查信件。他们于本月25日开始工作。

一百八十名新兵于本月26日上午从北方抵达吴淞。

X 据报，陈其美在过去几天里比往常更频繁地公开露面。他蓄起了胡须。

X 据报，伍廷芳和唐绍仪已致信在上海的反叛总部，否认有关他们同意在共和派与君主立宪派之间充当调停人的指控，并表示愿意捐款资助反叛方。

据报，一位名为岑春煊的反叛首领已从云南抵达此地。

本月26日，在兵工厂的一次午餐聚会上讨论政治时，副督军拉氏（La）与杨将军麾下的一名参谋军官王宏（Wong Ping）发生争吵并大打出手。包括杨将军和兵工厂总监在内的其他宾客从中调解，平息了争端。

您顺从的仆人，

首席探长。

警务处警司。

附于3月27日手稿。

Si Si Pao. 27-3-16. C. I. D.
F. O. REG
No. 202
Date 28/3/16

Since Kwangsi declared its independence the
attitude of Kwangtung has become clear. Yesterday
there were rumours among foreigners in Shanghai
that General Lung Chi 龍濟光 the Chiangchun
of Kwantung arrived here from Kwangtung by steamer
on Thursday last and is staying in the Palace Hotel.
His movements being secret, only a few persons
know of his arrival. He has brought 16 men with
him and these are also staying in the same hotel.
At 4 p.m. on Friday, the British Consul General
called on him and they talked for about two hours.
The object of Lung's visit to this port is unknown.
One of Lung's staff who is a native of the same
province as himself, is acting as Chiangchun
of Kwangtung.

Sir,
There is no truth in this
report.
J.F. Brenan
27/3/16.

（印：I. a mx）
page_data.zh:
《时事新报》。1916年3月27日。 C. I. D.
F. O. REG
第 202 号
日期 1916年3月28日

自广西宣布独立以来，广东的态度已变得明朗。昨日，在上海的外国人中流传着谣言，称广东都督龙济光将军于上周四乘轮船从广东抵达此地，现下榻于汇中饭店（Palace Hotel）。由于其行踪保密，仅有少数人知晓其抵达。他带来了16名随从，这些人也住在同一家酒店。

周五下午4时，英国总领事拜访了他，双方交谈了约两小时。龙氏访问本埠的目的尚不清楚。

龙氏的一名幕僚，与其同为该省籍贯，正在代理广东都督职务。

先生：

此报告不实。

J.F. Brenan
1916年3月27日。

（印：I. a mx）
